purpose: The Chandra X-ray Center's own analysis software, to re-run an archive observation's standard data processing from its level-1 products: chandra_repro (ciao-contrib) driving acis_process_events / hrc_process_events and the CIAO tools, against a pinned CALDB.
license: ciao, ciao-contrib, sherpa: GPL-3.0 (Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory). CALDB: calibration data released by the Chandra X-ray Center for public use.
platform: osx-arm64; the CXC conda channel publishes a native osx-arm64 build of ciao 4.18.0 (py312), so no x86_64 emulation is needed. CALDB is architecture-independent (noarch).
backgroundFiles: The caldb meta-package also pulls acis_bkg_evt (1.26 GB) and hrc_bkg_evt (2.24 GB), the blank-sky background event files. chandra_repro does not read them, so only caldb_main is pinned.
memory: chandra_repro on one ACIS-S observation streams the event list through acis_process_events; the level-1 event files this toolkit pins are tens of MB compressed, so the run stays far below the 2 GiB ceiling reprocess.mts enforces.
numpy: CIAO 4.18.0's pycrates imports numpy.chararray, which numpy 2.5 removed, so numpy is held below 2.4 although the ciao package accepts any numpy 2. Measured: with numpy 2.5.3 `import pycrates` fails with ImportError: cannot import name 'chararray'; with 2.3.5 it imports.
size: Installed: 7.1 GB, of which CALDB is 6.1 GB. Download: 2.5 GB over 217 packages; the install took 14.5 minutes on this machine.
